r17_extension.adversarial: Published date as actual receipt, treatment-confounder feedback ignored, population mix as within-group effect, inapplicable static method or rewritten preregistration fail.
r17_extension.removal: Remove actual exposure/announcement/target/method or returned-evidence binding while retaining version markers; independent effect oracle detects misattribution or required limitation.

tasks.deliverable: Extend existing GY V2/V3/V5/V7 and D3 benchmark consumers with a separate productive-capability comparison. Prepare the frozen corpus, independent semantics/oracles and method before freeze; execute the composed comparison in the single FINAL-REPLAY wave. Safety refusals, schema validity, fluent prose and retrieval hits do not demonstrate useful design or learning.
tasks.positive: A known-solvable real path produces material alternatives and a coherent document; all-abstain/all-no-op implementations cannot pass. Selected equal-ceiling comparisons report useful and harmful/null outcomes without universal superiority claims.
tasks.adversarial: Paraphrase inflation, invented model invocation, self-scored novelty, omitted failed arms, contaminated holdout, prompt-position legal exception loss, copied citations, unsupported enacted-law prose and hidden subgroup failures are caught. Unavailable live/audience inputs never become simulated authentic PASS.
tasks.removal: Remove generation, retrieval/feedback, numerical execution, source binding or document edit bridge one at a time but keep report markers; the corresponding actual endpoint fails or loses its measured effect.
tasks.surface: Reviewer/expert quality report resolving each candidate/case/evaluator/trace and limitations; GYD-22 consumes diagnostics. No authority is conferred by benchmark score.

tasks.owner_paths_role: Pinned research anchors, not blanket write permission. Exact native writer/consumer/companion closure rebind at P0; one lease per real semantic owner/shared path.
tasks.rollback: Suspend affected new use; preserve immutable history and legally permitted receipts; revert behavior by a forward repair/version, not history rewrite. Never restore revoked authority or rights.
tasks.migration: Version native artifacts and consumers where needed; legacy provenance/claims are not backfilled as verified. Read old outputs with explicit limits; re-evaluate only actual affected current uses.
tasks.input_resolution_rule: Classify missing inputs as internal engineering/allocation, existing source record, or genuine external fact/permission. Investigate native alternatives and supply internal gaps; only genuine external requirements justify a scoped hold.
genuine_external_inputs: Internal frozen cases and exact real-path suppliers; lawful live model access, selected independent reviewers/target readers and legitimate domain inputs for their respective claims. Sample size insufficient for superiority yields descriptive evidence.

tasks.final_execution_property: All R14 capability obligations in assurance/r14-capability-obligations.json accounted for by actual bound outputs, with unavailable evidence explicit; no promotion from benchmark score.
tasks.r14_review_refinement: Freeze a decision-relevant positive criterion, independently labelled, for designated known-solvable controls: a candidate answers the declared decision need or a specific acquisition/evidence path resolves it. Feasible diverse but irrelevant alternatives must not pass this criterion. All-null decision-support outcomes leave productive capability not_established even if plumbing passes. This is a bounded acceptance discriminator, never a useful_design_rate optimization/reward/promotion target. No-op and deliberate removal arms are comparators expected to fail productivity, not implementations required to produce an intervention. Reviewer panels belong to evaluation, not per-run/manual authority gates.

r15_extension.requirement: Add R15 trajectory/study discriminators and case-selected method profiles to the same frozen productive comparison. New controls join FINAL-REPLAY, not a second global wave; usefulness, authority and numerical correctness stay distinct.

r15_extension.adversarial: Omitted failed branches/sites/studies, future leakage, wrong population, biased inference, false feasibility or privacy claims cannot be hidden by aggregate pass rate.
r15_extension.removal: Remove actual trajectory, design discrimination or result-return consumer separately; preserve labels and verify loss of the respective endpoint.

r16_extension.requirement: Coordinate independent actual-path oracles for all selected R16 properties in existing final productive comparison. Preserve GY-AS2 and all previous obligations; math accuracy, useful design, external validity and authority are separate judgments.

r16_extension.adversarial: All-refusal pseudo-success, omitted failed alternatives or marker-based proof cannot establish capability.
r16_extension.removal: Remove real participant, rerun, influence, study or fresh surface independently; corresponding positive fails.

tasks.title: Design decision-informative studies and bind their returned evidence
requires_other_mechanisms: Native owner schemas/status/authority and full accepted-source consumer closure; no universal model or study DTO.

Interface agreement permits isolated preparation; composition needs actual selected producer outputs. DES-03 remains search writer, DES-04 feedback/acquisition bridge writer, GYD-30 joint witness owner.

Decision-bearing designer inputs are explicit/content-bound or declared hypothetical; defaults never become case facts. At protected dispatch/resume the native authority owner resolves the grant and recomputes coverage of EVERY load-bearing facet required by the actual operation/authorization contract, not a fixed checklist. Unresolved required scope refuses that action and claims of authorized conduct. Current-use rights/admission for already-returned evidence is a separate qualified decision.
tasks.deliverable: Extend existing CausalExperimentDesigner/ExperimentPlan and native acquisition/causal workflow to produce a versioned feasible study candidate discriminating decision-relevant rival explanations, with aligned sampling/assignment/measurement/analysis/stopping and actual result-return binding. Identifiability, finite-sample estimability and decision relevance remain distinct. Numeric EVSI is conditional, separate from compute VOI; no autonomous external study executor.
tasks.positive: An independently specified observationally equivalent model pair yields a feasible distinguishing design; a controlled owner-produced returned result reaches fresh claim consumer and changes only justified scope. A decision-equivalent alternative avoids unnecessary study; no operative world/posterior mutation without actual authorization.
tasks.adversarial: Uninformative repeated query, single-graph fallback intervention list, off-target receipt, adaptive unadjusted looks, mismatched target, fabricated permission or missing null outcomes cannot establish discriminating evidence. Current valid authorization for a different protocol/site, revoke before dispatch, or omitted decision-bearing basis filled by designer defaults cannot support the affected protected action or grounded numeric claim; explicit hypothetical scenarios remain candidates. Generic authorization falsifier: keep the grant valid and descriptive markers intact but change any native required operation facet (including recipient, population or intervention) outside its coverage, or add a new required facet. Actual owner coverage must fail; lawful bounded use of already-returned evidence is evaluated separately, not automatically erased.
tasks.removal: Remove actual discrimination or design-analysis-result/bridge binding while keeping study fields; oracle/consumer fails. Removing EVSI does not block a justified bounded acquisition route.
tasks.surface: Existing frontier/Cycle Board/reviewer dossier, API and authorized Atlas/document projection resolve actual native result, assumptions, observation cutoff, uncertainty, omitted alternatives and candidate/external-act boundaries.
tasks.migration: Legacy single-graph ExperimentPlan stays scoped; do not backfill rivals, preregistration, decision relevance or external authority.
genuine_external_inputs: Actual study permission/conduct/source rights and returned empirical evidence are external for their respective claims; internal design, analysis, adapter and consumer are engineering work. WP-01/02 activation remains independent of this plan and E02 acceptance.

conditional_composition_dependencies.when: A numeric scientific EVSI claim is selected; do not require for justified nonnumeric/bounded designs.

r16_extension.requirement: Consume new model-sensitive alternatives and revision history in existing study designer; design a feasible distinguishing information acquisition and bind returned actual evidence. Preserve original authorization, EVSI/compute-VOI distinction and no-default priors/budgets.
r16_extension.positive: A controlled informative return changes justified comparison; duplicated observationally equivalent information does not falsely resolve the distinction.
r16_extension.adversarial: Post-hoc scenario selection, independent-claim reuse of the same cohort, default probabilities or fabricated study execution cannot resolve a contested mechanism.
r16_extension.removal: Remove actual model-discrimination/result-return bridge while keeping protocol and completed labels; useful study-cycle oracle fails.

r17_extension.requirement: Bind method-qualified study/estimand to policy-strategy/exposure history, target weights, assignment versus receipt, preceding/concurrent policies and observation regime. Include announcement/anticipation when relevant; unknown awareness is scenario/bound/limitation. Use sufficient aggregate inputs when valid, not mandatory personal data.
r17_extension.positive: Partial rollout and later correction produce a supported target/exposure analysis and useful discriminating study; original protocol and as-known result remain distinct.
r17_extension.adversarial: Published date as actual receipt, treatment-confounder feedback ignored, population mix as within-group effect, inapplicable static method or rewritten preregistration fail.
r17_extension.removal: Remove actual exposure/announcement/target/method or returned-evidence binding while retaining version markers; independent effect oracle detects misattribution or required limitation.

question_slices.positive: Choose acquisition or show finite bounds when assumptions justify them.
question_slices.adversarial: Vary plausible selection toward unfavorable missing results; recommendation changes.
question_slices.removal: Remove denominator evidence and recompute; prior complete-synthesis claim cannot stand.

question_slices.delta: Separate candidate study design from rights-gated execution.
question_slices.positive: Profile advances internal design; collection still needs permission.
question_slices.adversarial: Treat compute profile as data/study permission.
question_slices.removal: Remove rights check; execution cannot be claimed.

question_slices.delta: Bind applicable commission/protocol/site permits separately from action-specific data-use grants; do not require irrelevant commission for secondary analysis.
question_slices.positive: Commissioned primary analysis: order v1 + applicable site permit + exact scoped analysis grant admits use. Secondary analysis: its own valid analysis-use grant admits scoped use without an irrelevant commission, subject to other applicable requirements.
question_slices.adversarial: Matched negative: order v1, applicable site permit and read-only grant are all valid, but analyze is withheld; protected analysis refuses/limits. Wrong site/version or revocation also fails.
question_slices.removal: Drop the action-specific grant check; a fresh protected-data reader refuses analysis/derivation even if order and read markers remain.

question_slices.delta: Bind protocol, actual looks/access, deviations and return.
question_slices.positive: Logged planned group-sequential looks retain that method guarantee.
question_slices.adversarial: Unlogged look/post-outcome target change limits.
question_slices.removal: Drop version/look link; support disappears.

question_slices.delta: Bind per-outcome denominator and raw presence/return.
question_slices.positive: Measured zero, absent and unreturned remain distinct.
question_slices.adversarial: Coerce null/no-return to zero with completion marker.
question_slices.removal: Drop outcome binding; fresh reader limits.

question_slices.delta: Bind return to next acquisition; separate gross EVSI, cost-based net value and capacity-based feasibility; no scheduler.
question_slices.positive: Joint return changes next choice; without cost/capacity, show conditional gross EVSI but withhold net value, cost/resource rank and feasibility.
question_slices.adversarial: Sum overlapping standalones or promote gross EVSI to net priority/feasibility without inputs.
question_slices.removal: Drop joint bridge; next choice changes; do not fill missing cost/capacity.
question_slices.role: scoped participant; primary writer only for this task’s existing owned predicate

question_slices.delta: Bind protocol/outcome/report and shared cohort.
question_slices.positive: Same cohort retains reports but one ancestry.
question_slices.adversarial: Registry, preprint, article, correction counted as four studies.
question_slices.removal: Drop lineage link; independence fails.
question_slices.role: scoped participant; consumer only for this task’s existing owned predicate

question_slices.delta: Propose study distinguishing harm from reporting shift.
question_slices.positive: Blind spot yields target-aligned candidate/result path.
question_slices.adversarial: Study repeats missing channel or fabricates result.
question_slices.removal: Remove discrimination/result binding; oracle finds no resolution.

question_slices.delta: Design feasible discriminator for decision-relevant transport rival.
question_slices.positive: Returned evidence changes only supported scope.
question_slices.adversarial: Study repeats bias or fabricates permission/result.
question_slices.removal: Remove result bridge; no transport question resolves.

question_slices.delta: Preserve R15-R17 study authorization/result binding and EVSI/compute-VOI split.
question_slices.positive: Bounded design stays candidate; result changes supported scope.
question_slices.adversarial: Fake permission/completion marker wins queue.
question_slices.removal: Remove result binding, keep fields; VOI consumer fails.

question_slices.delta: Only selected numeric EVSI; keep compute VOI separate.
question_slices.positive: Qualified result updates choice; bounded work needs no EVSI.
question_slices.adversarial: Invented priors/payoff fail numeric EVSI.
question_slices.removal: No EVSI need not block; no result bridge removes basis.

r19_extension.writer_rule: The original native owner and actual path lease remain authoritative; cross-owner route means a producer/consumer companion, not a second writer or a new global dependency.
